question: During the three days when Natsuki Subaru cross-dressed for his high-school debut without anyone finding out, did any of his classmates fall in love with him at first sight?
answer:
I've never thought about that! (laughs)

Just thinking about Subaru's high-school life after his cross-dressing was exposed is already painful enough!

Even though the disguise was good, if he actually spoke, he'd be found out immediately, so that would make things difficult.

And if he left home already dressed that way, his family would worry, so I think he probably changed somewhere on the way to school.

In terms of quality, then, he would definitely be below Natsumi Schwarz from Arc 7 and the others...

And compared to the cutest girl in the class, I don't think Subaru would be particularly cute.

So he probably wouldn't even be able to speak...

It's not something I've seriously considered, but I don't think there would have been any love at first sight!
